u2fd: Ignore unsupported vendor mode command Existing builds of cr50 support the vendor mode commands, but future builds will not. If we get a NoSuchCommand error, it means we are running against one of these newer builds, which do not have a notion of 'mode', and therefore we do not need to set it. Ignore such errors if we encounter them. metrics: migrate to generalized MOCK_METHOD() macro This CL replaces the uses of MOCK_METHOD*() and MOCK_CONST_METHOD*() macros in unit tests with the generalized MOCK_METHOD() macro, which is now the recommended way to define mocked methods with gmock. In particular, MOCK_METHOD() supports annotating a mocked method with specifiers such as 'override'. One minor change is that argument names are omitted in the argument list provided to MOCK_METHOD() in order to prevent clang-format from formatting code like `Foo* foo` into `Foo * foo`. pd_faft: Perform PDTester initiated items first, for safety reason In firmware_PDVbusRequest test, it performs: * DUT initiated items, which PDTester is fixed to 20V and DUT initates the requests of 5V, 12V, or 20V (or the max input voltage DUT supports). * PDTester initiated items, which PDTester changes to support max 5V, 12V, or 20V, and DUT reacts to request the max voltage. The DUT initiated items is more risky. If the DUT max input voltage is not 20V, like 12V, and the FAFT config is set wrong, it may negotiate to to a voltage higher than it can support, that may damage the DUT. The PDTester initiated items is safe. If the DUT max input voltage is not 20V, it tries to negotiate the best. So it should not damage the DUT. If it does damage DUT, this is also what we want to discover. This CL swaps the order and performs the PDTester initiated items first. If any item fails, possibly the FAFT config not set properly, it stops the test and doesn't perform the risky DUT initiated items. BUG=b:139372561 TEST=Ran firmware_PDVbusRequest. Made the PDTester initiated items failed and checked it not perform the DUT initiated items. Change-Id: I971c0383ca11754604a0ae57f6b074e7913809b2 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1823930 Tested-by: Wai-Hong Tam <waihong@google.com> Commit-Ready: Wai-Hong Tam <waihong@google.com> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Dana Goyette <dgoyette@chromium.org>
